package mediacontracts_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json/jsontext"
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	client "example.com/mediacontracts/gen/http/media_contracts/client"
	server "example.com/mediacontracts/gen/http/media_contracts/server"
	service "example.com/mediacontracts/gen/media_contracts"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
)

func TestMediaExchange(t *testing.T) {
	var calls atomic.Int32
	mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
	endpoint := func(_ context.Context, value any) (any, error) {
		calls.Add(1)
		return value, nil
	}
	server.Mount(mux, server.New(&service.Endpoints{Exchange: endpoint}, mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil, nil))
	remote := httptest.NewServer(mux)
	defer remote.Close()
	parsed, err := url.Parse(remote.URL)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	transport := client.NewClient(parsed.Scheme, parsed.Host, remote.Client(), loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
	binaryType := "application/octet-stream"
	note := "hello"
	var nullable service.Body
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"type":"nullable","value":null}`), &nullable))
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name  string
		body  service.Body
		media *string
	}{
		{"json", service.NewBodyJSON(42), nil},
		{"vendor", service.NewBodyVendor(7), nil},
		{"nullable", nullable, nil},
		{"text", service.NewBodyText("hello"), nil},
		{"binary", service.NewBodyBinary([]byte{0, 255}), &binaryType},
		{"form", service.NewBodyForm(&service.BodyForm{Name: &note, Note: &note, Numbers: []int{1, 2}, Labels: map[string]string{"a": "b"}}), nil},
		{"empty form", service.NewBodyForm(&service.BodyForm{}), nil},
		{"multipart", service.NewBodyMultipart(&service.BodyMultipart{Name: "file", Data: []byte{0, 255}}), nil},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			got, err := transport.Exchange()(context.Background(), &service.MediaEnvelope{Body: tc.body, ContentType: tc.media})
			require.NoError(t, err)
			result := got.(*service.MediaEnvelope)
			require.Equal(t, tc.body.Kind(), result.Body.Kind())
			switch tc.name {
			case "json":
				require.EqualValues(t, 42, result.Body.JSON)
			case "vendor":
				require.EqualValues(t, 7, result.Body.Vendor)
			case "text":
				require.EqualValues(t, "hello", result.Body.Text)
			case "binary":
				require.Equal(t, service.BodyBinary{0, 255}, result.Body.Binary)
			case "nullable":
				require.True(t, result.Body.Nullable.IsNull())
			case "form", "empty form":
				require.Equal(t, tc.body.Form, result.Body.Form)
			case "multipart":
				require.Equal(t, tc.body.Multipart, result.Body.Multipart)
			}
		})
	}
	require.EqualValues(t, 8, calls.Load())
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, media, body string
		status            int
	}{
		{"missing media", "", "42", 415},
		{"malformed media", "invalid", "42", 415},
		{"unsupported codec", "image/png", "data", 415},
		{"wrong JSON shape", "application/json", `"text"`, 400},
		{"empty JSON", "application/json", "", 400},
		{"whitespace JSON", "application/json", " \n\t", 400},
		{"null JSON", "application/json", "null", 400},
		{"truncated JSON", "application/json", "{", 400},
		{"constraint", "application/json", "101", 400},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			request, err := http.NewRequest("POST", remote.URL+"/media-contracts", strings.NewReader(tc.body))
			require.NoError(t, err)
			request.Header.Set("Content-Type", tc.media)
			response, err := remote.Client().Do(request)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			data, err := io.ReadAll(response.Body)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.NoError(t, response.Body.Close())
			require.Equal(t, tc.status, response.StatusCode, string(data))
			var problem map[string]any
			require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(data, &problem))
			wantCode := "decode_payload"
			switch {
			case tc.status == 415:
				wantCode = "unsupported_media_type"
			case tc.name == "empty JSON" || tc.name == "whitespace JSON":
				wantCode = "missing_payload"
			case tc.name == "constraint":
				wantCode = "invalid_range"
			}
			require.Equal(t, wantCode, problem["code"])
			require.NotEmpty(t, problem["detail"])
			require.EqualValues(t, 8, calls.Load())
		})
	}
	wrongType := "text/plain"
	_, err = transport.Exchange()(context.Background(), &service.MediaEnvelope{Body: service.NewBodyJSON(1), ContentType: &wrongType})
	require.Error(t, err)
	require.EqualValues(t, 8, calls.Load())
}

func TestOptionalMediaBody(t *testing.T) {
	mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
	var calls atomic.Int32
	var present atomic.Bool
	endpoint := func(_ context.Context, value any) (any, error) {
		calls.Add(1)
		present.Store(value.(*service.OptionalPayload).Choice != nil)
		return "ok", nil
	}
	server.Mount(mux, server.New(&service.Endpoints{Optional: endpoint}, mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil, nil))
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, media, body string
		status            int
		present           bool
	}{
		{"absent", "", "", 200, false},
		{"empty JSON", "application/json", "", 200, false},
		{"zero JSON", "application/json", "0", 200, true},
		{"empty text", "text/plain", "", 200, true},
		{"empty form", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded", "", 200, true},
		{"untyped body", "", "0", 415, false},
		{"null", "application/json", "null", 400, false},
		{"truncated", "application/json", "{", 400, false},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			before := calls.Load()
			request := httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/media-contracts/optional", strings.NewReader(tc.body))
			request.Header.Set("Content-Type", tc.media)
			writer := httptest.NewRecorder()
			mux.ServeHTTP(writer, request)
			require.Equal(t, tc.status, writer.Code, writer.Body.String())
			if tc.status == 200 {
				require.Equal(t, before+1, calls.Load())
				require.Equal(t, tc.present, present.Load())
			} else {
				require.Equal(t, before, calls.Load())
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestMediaErrors(t *testing.T) {
	failure := &service.MediaFailure{Detail: service.NewDetailText("rejected")}
	for _, formatted := range []bool{false, true} {
		writer := httptest.NewRecorder()
		var formatter func(context.Context, error) loomhttp.StatusCoder
		if formatted {
			formatter = loomhttp.NewErrorResponse
		}
		encode := server.EncodeFailError(loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, formatter)
		require.NoError(t, encode(context.Background(), writer, failure))
		require.Equal(t, 400, writer.Code)
		if formatted {
			require.Contains(t, writer.Header().Get("Content-Type"), "json")
			require.True(t, jsontext.Value(writer.Body.Bytes()).IsValid())
		} else {
			require.Equal(t, "text/plain", writer.Header().Get("Content-Type"))
			require.Equal(t, "rejected", writer.Body.String())
		}
	}
}
